run_evaluate_scraper: run the evaluate function to test a web scraper program against HTML documentation test cases
run_get_test_cases: run get_test_cases to retrieve HTML test cases with expected function extraction results
run_evaluate_extraction: run evaluate_extraction to compare extracted documentation against expected results and score accuracy
run_generate_feedback: run generate_feedback to produce detailed LLM improvement feedback from evaluation metrics and artifacts
run_evaluate_combined_score: run evaluate to compute a combined_score from accuracy completeness and robustness metrics for evolution
